sources.title: LTX-2.5: LTX's Latest AI Open-Source Foundation Model | LTX
sources.snippet: LTX-2.5 is the newest version of LTX, an open-weights world model for video generation. It's built as a stronger foundation, not just a new tool, that teams can build on, fine-tune, and deploy themselves.

sources.title: LTX-2.5 | LTX Documentation
sources.snippet: LTX-2.5 comes in two variants: ltx-2-5-fast for speed and low cost, and ltx-2-5-pro for higher fidelity. Fast produces portrait and landscape video up to 4K; Pro tops out at 1080p. LTX-2.5 improves every stage of generation on a stronger foundation: a Diffusion Video Decoder with industry-leading pixel quality, higher fidelity, native multi-shot scenes, and a better distilled model.
